paper: A Sanity Check for AI-generated Image Detection (Yan et al., ICLR 2025)
training_set_in_paper: Two settings. Setting-I (B1 AIGCDetectBenchmark): trained on 4-class? -> whole-class ProGAN (CNNSpot/ForenSynths, real=LSUN, fake=ProGAN, 360k). Setting-I (B2 GenImage): trained on ImageNet reals + SDv1.4 fakes (324k). Setting-II (B3 Chameleon): trained on ProGAN, or SDv1.4, or 'All GenImage' (paper sec.4.1/Tables 10,11). 5 epochs, AdamW, blr=1e-4 on B1 / 5e-4 on B2, bs=32, 8xA100; aug = random JPEG QF~U(30,100) p=0.1 + Gaussian blur sigma~U(0.1,3.0) p=0.1.

benchmarks.name: AIGCDetectBenchmark (B1, Setting-I, ProGAN-trained)
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 3 (p.8); AP version Table 12 (appendix). Trained on ProGAN per text 'all methods except DIRE-D trained on ProGAN'.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Official data/datasets.py TestDataset: NO resize of the input image. transform_before_test=ToTensor only -> DCT_base_Rec_Module runs on NATIVE resolution (unfold window=32 stride=16 over full image, K=6 band-pass filters, log|DCT|+1, 2k=weight, pick 2 highest + 2 lowest patches). Selected patches AND x_0 token are then Resize([256,256])+Normalize(ImageNet); semantic branch CLIP-remaps ImageNet->CLIP, ConvNeXt-XXL asserts (3072,8,8). softmax[:,1], acc@0.5 + AP. Checkpoint AIDE_checkpoints/progan_train.pth.

our_number.note: SynthScope metric is mAP/mean-AP over the 17 on-disk AIGCDetect generators (adds sd_xl); acc 91.89 ~ paper 92.77. tag=aide_official_aigcdetect 2026-06-05, official progan_train.pth in vendored faithful eval.

benchmarks.gap_cause: none for official-weights faithful eval. SynthScope-class trained-from-scratch (registry default) only reached 72.25 mAP / 61.64 acc on AIGCDetect because of the native-res DCT divergence (see GenImage entry).

benchmarks.name: GenImage (B2, Setting-I, SDv1.4-trained)
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 4 (p.7-8). Trained on ImageNet reals + SDv1.4 fakes, eval over 8 generators.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same TestDataset path: native-res DCT patch selection, patches+token resized to 256 + ImageNet-norm, ConvNeXt-XXL semantic branch. Checkpoint AIDE_checkpoints/sd14_train.pth. (A GenImage_train.pth checkpoint also exists and scores ~99.96 mAP but that is trained on the full GenImage train, not the paper's SDv1.4-only Setting-I.)

our_number.note: official sd14_train.pth, faithful vendored eval; acc 85.91 ~ paper 86.88 (tag aide_official_genimage8). FROM-SCRATCH reproduction (native-res 5-view, aide_native_v2/model_2): GenImage-8 96.42 mAP / 97.07 mAUROC / 77.9 acc (tag aide_retrain_native_g8) = reproduces official 97.12. The old resize-256 retrains (91.75 / 92.47) were capped by the resize-before-DCT bug.

benchmarks.gap_cause: RESOLVED. The native-res DCT (the patch selector must run at native resolution; resize-256-before-DCT costs ~12 mAP on the same weights, ablation) is now wired into BOTH serving and training. A from-scratch retrain reproduces (96.42 ~ official 97.12).

benchmarks.name: Chameleon (B3, Setting-II, in-the-wild)

paper_per_generator.note: Per-category not broken out; Table 1 statistics = 14,863 real + 11,170 fake (Scene 3574/2976, Object 3578/2016, Animal 3998/313, Human 3713/5865). Table 5 reports overall Acc + 'fake/real' acc split: AIDE ProGAN 58.37 (5.04/98.46), SDv1.4 62.60 (20.33/94.38), All-GenImage 65.77 (26.80/95.06).

benchmarks.paper_section: Sec.3 (dataset, Table 1) + Table 5 (p.8, results). Headline contribution of the paper.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same AIDE TestDataset native-res-DCT path; trained under each of ProGAN / SDv1.4 / 'All GenImage' to show Setting-II generalization. Chameleon is the paper's own collected in-the-wild test set (11k+ AI images from art/civitai/lib + real photos from Unsplash).
